exposure: target gestational age for delivery (34 weeks)
target gestational age for delivery (35 weeks)
cohort: The study included singleton pregnancies with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) after 24 weeks, delivered between 2006 and 2014.
finding: A 35-week target for delivery timing in women with PPROM, compared to a 34-week target, did not decrease NICU admissions or neonatal length of stay, but it did increase maternal predelivery length of stay.
gest_age: PPROM occurred after 24 weeks gestation, with a mean gestational age at PPROM of 31.0-31.2 weeks and mean gestational age at delivery of 31.8-32.4 weeks.
